section1.title: 1. General
section1.content: We take the protection of personal data seriously. This Privacy Policy explains which personal data we process when you use DumbleScore: on the website dumblescore.com, in the Android app, in the Telegram bot and when you access DumbleScore through connected AI apps. Where the processing differs depending on how you access the service, this is stated. Section 9 additionally applies to the Android app.

section3.title: 3. Data Collected
section3.content: Depending on how you use DumbleScore, we process the following personal data:
items: Visiting the website without an account: IP address and browser identifier (user agent). For our own usage statistics, also a short identifier that is calculated from the IP address and the browser identifier and whose key changes every three days, the pages viewed and actions taken, device type, browser, language, referring page, campaign details (UTM) and landing page.

Account: email address; when you sign in with Google, also your Google identifier, first and last name and the address of your profile picture; when you sign in with Telegram, your Telegram user ID, your username and your first and last name. In addition: language, country, time zone, time of registration, your acceptance of the Terms of Service (version and time), your consent to marketing emails, your cookie choice for the “Marketing” category and your notification settings.
Origin of the registration: referring page, campaign details (UTM), landing page, referral or coupon code and, if you came through a partner's link, its click identifier.

Sign-in and sessions: when you request a sign-in link by email, the email address, the IP address and the language; at every sign-in, including with Google or Telegram, the time, the sign-in method, the IP address and the browser or app identifier (user agent); for each signed-in device or browser, a session with the device identifier (a random ID in the browser; in the Android app, the app's device identifier), IP address, browser or app identifier and the time of last use.
Protection of the free allowance: which accounts were signed in on the same device (device identifier, IP address, browser identifier, sign-in method, first and last time).
Use with an account: unlocked analyses and the status of your allowance, your favorite teams, the pages viewed and actions taken, and your messages to support.

Subscription and payments: the plan chosen, its term, cancellation, the purchase channel (on the website through Stripe, in the Android app through Google Play), and the respective payment provider's customer, subscription and order references. For each payment, the amount, currency, tax amount (where known), country of payment and a redeemed code. For a purchase through Google Play, also the details named in section 9.
Telegram bot: Telegram user ID, username, first and last name, language, region and time zone settings, and what you enter in the bot.
Android app: see section 9.
Connected AI apps: the request log (see section 8).
section3.note: We do not store or process credit card details or full payment information. Server logs containing the IP address are kept by the hosting provider for a short time for operation and security. With your consent, third-party analytics and marketing services additionally collect pseudonymized usage data on the website (see section 6).

section4.title: 4. Purpose and Legal Basis of Processing
section4.content: We process personal data for the following purposes:
items: Technical operation of the website, the Android app and the Telegram bot, including signing in and staying signed in on several devices

Providing the analyses, managing the free allowance and the subscriptions, billing through the respective payment provider (Stripe or Google Play), matching and verifying purchases, refunds and bookkeeping
Notifications you have set up (in the Android app as push notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging) and emails about your account; marketing emails only with your consent
Stability, security and abuse prevention, including limiting the number of requests
Protecting the free allowances against abuse, in particular detecting several free accounts on the same device (these device links are deleted 90 days after they were last used)
Determining the country from the IP address in order to show prices in your currency and to evaluate where registrations come from
Our own usage statistics to improve the service
On the website: measuring advertising with your consent and settling the partner program (see section 6)
section4.note: Processing is based on the performance of the contract with you, on our legitimate interest in a secure, reliable and economically viable operation, and on legal obligations. Processing for analytics and marketing purposes by Google and Meta takes place only with your consent; you can withdraw it at any time via the cookie settings. The reports to the partner program (section 6) are based on our legitimate interest in paying partners correctly.

section5.title: 5. Third-Party Service Providers
section5.content: To operate our services, we use the following third-party providers, which receive data in the process:
items: Microsoft Azure (hosting and database; data center in the West Europe region, Netherlands)

Stripe (payment processing for the subscriptions taken out on the website; Stripe acts as the reseller, the “Merchant of Record”, for the purchase, collects the payment, issues the invoice and accounts for the taxes)
Mailgun (sending emails about your account, for example the sign-in link and notifications)
Brevo (marketing emails, only with your consent: email address, name, language, time zone, date of registration, subscription plan and its expiry)
Telegram (messaging platform of the bot and sign-in with Telegram)

Google: sign-in with Google (website and Android app); Firebase Cloud Messaging for the Android app's push notifications (here Google acts on our behalf as a processor and receives the app's Firebase installation ID or registration token as well as the content of the notification); Google Play for subscriptions taken out in the Android app (Google handles the purchase and the payment under its own responsibility; our server queries Google for the status of a purchase using the purchase token); with your consent, Google Analytics on the website
ipinfo.io (receives the IP address in order to determine the country)
Sportmonks (data supplier; your device loads crests and images of teams, leagues and players directly from its servers, which for technical reasons receive your IP address)
Meta Platforms Ireland Limited (measuring advertising, website only and only with your consent)
impact.com (partner program, website only and only if you came to us through a partner)
Anthropic and OpenAI, if you yourself connect an AI app to your account (section 8)
section5.note: Payments are handled exclusively by the respective payment provider: on the website by Stripe, in the Android app by Google Play. We receive references and details of the payment (for example amount, currency and order number), but no credit card or bank details. The Android app exchanges data with our own servers, loads images from Sportmonks as described above and uses only those Google services described in section 9 (push notifications, purchase through Google Play, sign-in with Google). Nothing is reported to Meta or impact.com for the app.

section5a.title: 6. Web Analytics and Marketing
section5a.content: This section applies to the website. In the Android app and in the Telegram bot we do not use any third-party analytics or marketing services.

subsections.title: Our own usage statistics
subsections.content: On our own servers we count which pages and features of the website are used, without cookies and without third-party services. For visits without an account we use a short identifier made from the IP address and the browser identifier, whose key changes every three days; the IP address itself is not stored for this. If you register, the preceding page views of the same visit are assigned to your account. For signed-in accounts we store the page views with the account and, at sign-in, the IP address as well. We delete entries of visits without an account after 13 months.

subsections.title: Google Analytics 4
subsections.content: With your consent (“Analytics” category), the website uses Google Analytics 4, a web analytics service of Google Ireland Limited. Google Analytics uses cookies and similar technologies that make it possible to analyze how the website is used. The information generated is generally transferred to Google servers and stored there.

subsections.title: Meta (Facebook) Pixel and Conversions API
subsections.content: With your consent (“Marketing” category), we use technologies of Meta Platforms Ireland Limited so that we can measure the effect of our ads. The website then loads the Meta Pixel, which records page views and technical characteristics of your device and may set cookies. In addition, our server reports your registration and your payments on the website to Meta (Conversions API); for this purpose we store your cookie choice with your account when you sign in. Meta receives your email address, your first and last name, your country and your internal user number, each only as a hash value, as well as your IP address; for payments, the amount, currency and subscription plan are added. Without your consent nothing is reported, and never for accounts that were opened in the Android app.

subsections.title: Partner program (impact.com)
subsections.content: If you come to us through a partner's link or coupon code, we report your registration and your payments to impact.com so that the partner is paid. We transmit the click identifier of the partner link, your internal user number, your IP address, a hash value of your email address and, for payments, the amount and currency. Without a partner link or partner code nothing is reported.

section6a.title: 7. Cookies and Consent
section6a.content:
The website uses cookies and similar technologies for analytics and marketing purposes (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel) only if you have given your consent beforehand. You can withdraw your consent at any time via the cookie settings in the footer.

Without consent, the website stores only what is needed for operation: your cookie choice and the chosen appearance (cookies) and, in the browser's local storage, your sign-in, the random device identifier, your settings and notices already shown. Also in local storage, the website remembers where your visit came from (campaign details, referring page, landing page, a partner's click identifier, coupon code); these details are stored with your account when you register.

The Android app does not use cookies.

sectionAiApps.title: 8. AI Apps (Claude, ChatGPT)
sectionAiApps.content: You can connect your DumbleScore account to AI apps such as Claude (Anthropic) or ChatGPT (OpenAI). With your consent, the AI app retrieves data from your account via our interface (MCP). We do not see your conversation with the AI app; we only receive the individual requests the app sends to us. For each request we store:
items: Your user ID and the connected app (e.g. Claude or ChatGPT)
The function called and its parameters (e.g. date, league, match)
Result status, duration, size of the response and time
sectionAiApps.note: Purpose: operating the service, protection against abuse, usage limits and improving our service. The request log is deleted after 365 days. We do not store additional details that an AI app sends along with a request (e.g. location or device). Our responses go to the AI app you chose and are processed there under its provider's privacy policy (Anthropic: anthropic.com/legal/privacy, OpenAI: openai.com/policies/privacy-policy). You can disconnect an AI app at any time in your account under “Claude & ChatGPT”; access ends with the next request.

sectionApp.title: 9. Android App
sectionApp.content: The Android app can be used without an account. It contains no third-party analytics, tracking, advertising or crash-reporting libraries, shows no advertising and uses no cookies. It uses three services from Google, each only for its purpose: Firebase Cloud Messaging for push notifications, Google Play for purchasing a subscription, and sign-in with Google. We process the following about your device and your use of the app:
items: A random device identifier and a device key, which the app generates itself when it is first started (only a hash value of the key is kept on our server). The identifier is not an identifier of the phone and not an advertising ID. If you sign in to the app with an account, we link the device to that account until you sign out in the app or the account is deleted.
Platform, language, time zone and app version
Your favorite teams (at most ten)
Your choice of notifications (league, team or match; goals, red cards, final score); if you are signed in, it belongs to your account
The time of the first and of the last contact; for this, the app reports to our server once a week

Push notifications: only when you switch on a notification in the app and Android allows notifications to be shown does the app start Firebase Cloud Messaging, a Google service; before that, it does not contact Firebase. Google then assigns a Firebase installation ID to this installation of the app (on phones with older Google Play services, a registration token instead). We store this push address with your device identifier and use it to send the notifications you have chosen. Google delivers them and for this receives the push address and the content of the notification (for example the match and the score). For each match notification, we store for 30 days which device it was sent to and whether delivery succeeded. For notifications about your account (for example about a new analysis or a reply from support), this record stays with the account for as long as it exists.

Subscription through Google Play: if you take out a subscription in the app, Google Play handles the purchase and the payment and processes your payment data under its own responsibility; we do not receive credit card or bank details. So that the purchase can be matched to your account, the app passes Google a random identifier of your account (not your email address) at the time of purchase. We receive from Google and store: the purchase token, the order number, the product with base plan and offer, the state of the subscription (for example active, canceled, expired) and whether it renews, the times of purchase, expiry, cancellation and refund, the country of purchase, the amount, currency and tax of the payment, and Google's most recent response about this purchase verbatim. Google also notifies us of changes to the subscription (for example renewal, cancellation, refund). We use these details to unlock access, to check the status of the subscription, to prevent abuse and for our bookkeeping.

Sign-in with Google: in the app, it runs through Android's sign-in feature and your phone's Google Play services. We receive from Google the same details as on the website: Google identifier, email address, first and last name and the address of your profile picture (section 3).
sectionApp.note: The app asks only for permission to show notifications and for no permission to access location, contacts, camera, microphone or files. Without an account, our interface uses the IP address only briefly in memory to limit the number of requests and does not store it with the device identifier. If you sign in to the app with an account, we store the IP address and app identifier with the sign-in and the session, as on the website (section 3). The appearance setting is kept only on your phone; as stated above, we also store the language with the device identifier. The app loads images (crests of teams and leagues, player images) directly from the servers of our data supplier (section 5). With “Delete device data” in the app's settings you immediately delete the device identifier, push address, favorite teams and notifications of the device on our server; the app then also deletes its Firebase installation at Google. If a device has not reported for 60 days, we delete its data automatically. If an account that the app was linked to is deleted, we disconnect the device from the account; it continues to exist as a device without an account (device identifier, push address and the favorite teams and notifications stored for the device) until you choose “Delete device data” or the device has not reported for 60 days.

section8.title: 10. International Data Transfers
section8.content: Our servers and our database are located in the European Union (Netherlands). Some of the third-party providers named in section 5 have their registered office or data centers outside Switzerland and the European Economic Area, in particular in the USA. This also applies to Google: for the Android app's push notifications (Firebase Cloud Messaging), Google processes the Firebase installation ID or the registration token and the content of the notifications on servers in the USA as well. In these cases, the transfer takes place on the basis of the EU standard contractual clauses or the Data Privacy Framework, which these providers include in their data processing agreements.

section9.title: 11. Data Retention
section9.content:
Personal data is stored only for as long as is necessary for the purposes stated or as statutory retention obligations require. In detail:

Account and related data, including the usage statistics for the account: for as long as the account exists.
After an account is deleted: we delete the account together with the details about you, in particular the email address, name, sign-in data, sessions, settings, the account's favorite teams and notifications, unlocked analyses, messages to support, and the connections to Telegram and to AI apps. The following remain, detached from the account: orders and payment records (amount, date, plan, redeemed code, country of payment, the payment providers' order and receipt numbers) and Stripe's payment notifications; for a purchase through Google Play, the purchase token with the details named in section 9 and the random account identifier; our requests to Stripe to process payments (former account number, reference at Stripe and reason); the usage statistics entries without IP address, browser identifier and additional details; the request log of connected AI apps without the user ID. The periods below apply to them. Stripe and Google keep the data about your payments under their own responsibility according to their own rules; your customer record at Stripe is not deleted by the deletion on our side.
Orders, payment records, Stripe's payment notifications, payment processing requests and purchases through Google Play: for as long as is necessary for billing, refunds and the statutory retention of business records (ten years in Switzerland).
Notifications from Google Play about changes to a subscription: 90 days after they have been processed.
Usage statistics of a deleted account: like visits without an account, 13 months after the respective entry.
Our own usage statistics of visits without an account: 13 months.
Sessions: a session expires 30 days after it was last used and is then deleted.
Device links for protecting the free allowance: 90 days after they were last used.
Sign-in links by email: one day after they expire.
Assignment of IP address to country: as a hash value of the IP address, for one month at most.
Request log of connected AI apps: 365 days.
Android app: device identifier, push address (Firebase installation ID or registration token), favorite teams and notifications until you choose “Delete device data” in the app's settings, and at the latest until 60 days after the device's last contact; this also applies to a device whose account has been deleted. We also delete the push address as soon as Google reports it as invalid. The delivery log of the match notifications sent by push is deleted after 30 days (the record for notifications to an account belongs to the account), the notification choice for an individual match two days after the match.
Server logs containing the IP address: for a short time at the hosting provider.
Analytics and marketing cookies: until you withdraw your consent, or according to the periods of the respective provider.

section10.title: 12. User Rights
section10.content:
Within the scope of the applicable data protection laws, you have the right to obtain information about your personal data, to have it corrected or deleted, to have its processing restricted and to receive it (data portability), as well as the right to object to processing and to withdraw consent at any time. Please send requests to the address given above.

Some things you can do yourself: in the Android app, “Delete device data” in the settings deletes the device identifier, the push address, the favorite teams and the notifications of the device on our server. You change your cookie consent via the website's cookie settings, you unsubscribe from marketing emails via the link in every email, you switch off push notifications in the app or in Android's settings, and you disconnect an AI app in your account.

Deleting your account: you delete your account yourself, in the Android app under “Account” with “Delete account”, or on the website under “My Account”. For security, you sign in again immediately beforehand; if two-factor sign-in is set up, you also enter its code. A subscription taken out on the website ends immediately upon deletion. If a subscription is running through Google Play, cancel it in Google Play first. Once it has been canceled, we schedule the deletion and carry it out after the end of the paid term; for this purpose we store the time of your request. Until then, you can cancel the scheduled deletion in the app or on the website; if you resume the subscription, the scheduled deletion is put on hold. If you cannot sign in or no longer have an account, request the deletion by email to support@dumblescore.com. We may require a confirmation via the email address stored for the account or, for an account that is connected only to Telegram, via that Telegram account. We confirm the scheduling and the deletion by email, provided an email address is stored for the account. What remains after the deletion, and for how long, is set out in section 11. The Android app's device continues to exist without an account until you choose “Delete device data” there or it has not reported for 60 days (section 9).

You can also lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority, in Switzerland with the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).

section11.title: 13. Changes to This Privacy Policy
section11.content: This Privacy Policy may be updated where necessary to reflect legal, technical or operational changes. The version published on the website and in the app at the time applies.

section1.title: 1. Scope
section1.content: These Terms of Service govern the use of DumbleScore: the website dumblescore.com, the Android app, the Telegram bot and access through connected AI apps. The provider is Inscribe GmbH, Signalstrasse 11, 4058 Basel, Switzerland.

section2.title: 2. Service Description
section2.content:
DumbleScore provides statistical and data-driven analyses of football matches for informational purposes: probabilities, assessments and forecasts for matches, and opportunities where our analysis differs from a market price.

It is expressly not betting advice, a gambling service or an invitation to take part in gambling. DumbleScore does not accept stakes, does not broker stakes and does not place anything on your behalf. Odds of third-party providers are stated for information only; DumbleScore does not link to these providers.

The content is intended for your own use. Passing it on commercially and reading it out by automated means are not permitted without our consent.

section3.title: 3. No Guarantee
section3.content: All analyses and information are provided without warranty. No guarantee is given for accuracy, completeness, timeliness or financial success. Past results say nothing reliable about future results. Uninterrupted availability of the services is not owed.

section4.title: 4. User Responsibility
section4.content: The analyses are used solely at the user's own responsibility. Decisions made on the basis of the information provided rest entirely with the user. This includes complying with the laws that apply at the user's place of residence.

section5.title: 5. Account, Free Access and Subscriptions
section5.content:
Account: you open an account with your email address, with Google or with Telegram. The account is personal; access must not be passed on to third parties. The Android app can also be used without an account.

Free access: with a free account, a limited allowance of analyses is available to you. The allowance applies per person; several free accounts on the same device share one common, limited allowance. We may change the scope and conditions of free access at any time.

Subscriptions: paid subscriptions extend access as described for the respective plan. The price and the scope of services are shown before you subscribe. A subscription runs for one month and renews for a further month each time until you cancel it. After a cancellation, access remains until the end of the paid term. The subscription belongs to your account. Payment, renewal, cancellation and refunds depend on where it was taken out: on the website or in the Android app.

Subscriptions taken out on the website: the purchase is processed through Stripe. Stripe acts as the reseller (“Merchant of Record”), collects the payment, issues the invoice and accounts for the taxes. The Stripe terms shown at purchase apply in addition. You can cancel such a subscription at any time in your account on the website with effect from the end of the paid term.

Subscriptions taken out in the Android app: the purchase is processed through Google Play and paid for via your Google account. The Google Play Terms of Service apply in addition to payment, billing and renewal. You can cancel such a subscription at any time in Google Play (Subscriptions) with effect from the end of the paid term; it cannot be canceled in your DumbleScore account or by uninstalling the app, and we cannot cancel it for you. Refunds are governed by section 6.

Deleting your account: you can delete your account at any time, in the Android app under “Account” and on the website under “My Account”. Your access ends with the deletion. A subscription taken out on the website ends immediately upon deletion; the term already paid for is not refunded. Your right to a refund under section 6 remains: if you delete your account within the 14 days, you can request the refund within this period by email to support@dumblescore.com even after the deletion. If a subscription was taken out through Google Play, cancel it in Google Play first. Once it has been canceled, we schedule the deletion and carry it out after the end of the paid term; until then, you can cancel the scheduled deletion. As long as such a subscription has not been canceled or a payment is pending in Google Play, the account cannot be deleted.

Digital service: the analyses are digital content and are available immediately once unlocked. With the unlocking, the service is deemed to have been provided.

section6.title: 6. Refund Policy
section6.content: Subscriptions taken out on the website: customers have the right to request a full refund within 14 days of purchase, without providing any reason. Refund requests made within this 14-day period will be honored in full, regardless of usage. Refunds are processed via the original payment method. Please send requests by email to support@dumblescore.com.\n\nSubscriptions taken out in the Android app through Google Play: refunds are governed by Google Play's refund policies. You submit the request to Google Play; in every case, the refund is made through Google Play to the payment method used there. If Google Play rejects a request or Google Play's time limit has expired, you can contact support@dumblescore.com; we will review your request. Statutory rights of withdrawal and rescission to which you are mandatorily entitled at your place of residence remain reserved.
section6.contentApp: Subscriptions taken out in the Android app through Google Play: refunds are governed by Google Play's refund policies. You submit the request to Google Play; in every case, the refund is made through Google Play to the payment method used there. If Google Play rejects a request or Google Play's time limit has expired, you can contact support@dumblescore.com; we will review your request. Statutory rights of withdrawal and rescission to which you are mandatorily entitled at your place of residence remain reserved.

section7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
section7.content: Inscribe GmbH is liable for damage it causes intentionally or through gross negligence. Otherwise, liability is excluded to the extent permitted by law. This applies in particular to direct or indirect damage, financial losses or lost profits arising from the use of the analyses provided or from decisions based on them, and to errors in data that originates from third parties.

section8.title: 8. Age Restriction
section8.content: Use of DumbleScore is permitted only for persons aged 18 or over.

section9.title: 9. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
section9.content: Swiss law applies exclusively. The place of jurisdiction is the registered office of Inscribe GmbH. Mandatory statutory places of jurisdiction remain reserved.

section10.title: 10. Changes to These Terms
section10.content: Inscribe GmbH reserves the right to amend these Terms at any time. The version valid at the time of use applies. When there is a new version, we ask accounts for their acceptance at the next sign-in.

section11.title: 11. Account Suspension and Abuse Prevention
section11.content: Inscribe GmbH reserves the right to restrict, suspend or permanently terminate user accounts in the event of abuse of the services or of behavior that indicates use in bad faith. Abuse includes in particular circumventing the free allowance with several accounts, passing on access and reading out the content by automated means. Such measures may be taken independently of any refund granted and do not affect the right to a refund under section 6.
